name: Xperia E

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia miro, Sony Xperia tipo

Network.Technology: GSM GPRS/EDGE (telecommunication), EDGE 850, 900, 1800, 1900, UMTS High Speed Packet Access, HSPA 850 (Band V), 1900 (Band II), 2100 (Band I) in the Americas, UMTS HSPA 900 (Band VIII), 2100 (Band I) in regions other than the Americas.

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.1.1 "Jelly Bean", Experimental version of Firefox OS

Memory.RAM: 512 MB RAM (409 MB available to user)
Memory.Storage: 750 MB phone storage, 4 GB internal SD card (2 GB available to user)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth v2.1 + EDR with A2DP, aGPS, DLNA, Wi-Fi IEEE 802.11b/g/n
